Definition: from G5475; a copper-worker or brazier:--coppersmith.
BiblicalUsage: Chalkeus is a coppersmith, a worker in brass — and it appears once, in Paul's warning: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil, and the Lord will reward him according to his works.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a trade is not a character, and Alexander is the proof: he worked in brass and did evil, and Paul leaves him to the Lord.
